dialog_history.content: Do you have any shortness of breath or worsening difficulty breathing compared with your usual baseline?
Yes. My breathing feels worse than my usual COPD baseline, and I notice more wheezing when I exhale.
intermediate_choice=I
Do you have shortness of breath or chest pain that is worse when you breathe in?
No, I don’t have shortness of breath or chest pain that gets worse when I breathe in. My main problems are fever, cough, and the throat pain/hoarseness.
intermediate_choice=B
How long have your symptoms been going on (in days)?
It’s been about 2 weeks. I had a cold recently, and then these symptoms started around that time and have continued.
intermediate_choice=AA
What is your temperature (how high is the fever) and do you have any chills or night sweats?
I don’t know the exact number, but I do have a fever. Yes, I’ve had chills, but I don’t think I’ve had night sweats.
intermediate_choice=E
Do you have any shortness of breath at rest, and what is your oxygen saturation (SpO₂) if you’ve measured it?
No, I don’t have shortness of breath at rest. I haven’t measured my oxygen saturation (SpO₂).
intermediate_choice=B
Do you have any trouble swallowing saliva, drooling, or a muffled “hot potato” voice?
No drooling. I don’t think I have trouble swallowing my saliva. My voice is hoarse, but it’s not a muffled “hot potato” voice.
intermediate_choice=E
Have you had any shortness of breath or wheezing with exertion, or any measured oxygen saturation (SpO₂) if available?
I don’t have shortness of breath with exertion, and I haven’t measured my oxygen saturation.
intermediate_choice=E
Have you had any abnormal lung findings or chest X‑ray results (e.g., have you been told you have pneumonia)?
No. I haven’t had any chest X‑ray or been told I have pneumonia.
intermediate_choice=E
Have you had any facial pain or pressure (especially when bending forward) or nasal congestion/discharge?
No facial pain or pressure when bending forward. I don’t have nasal congestion or nasal discharge that I’ve noticed.
intermediate_choice=E
Do you have a sore throat when swallowing, and have you noticed any white patches on your tonsils or swollen/tender neck lymph nodes?
Yes, it’s painful in my throat when I swallow. I don’t know about white patches on my tonsils, and I’m not sure about swollen or tender neck lymph nodes.
intermediate_choice=E
Have you noticed any white patches or pus on your tonsils, or swollen/tender lumps in the front of your neck?
I have right and left tonsil pain, but I haven’t noticed any white patches or pus. I’m not sure about swollen or tender lumps in the front of my neck.
intermediate_choice=R
Where exactly is the “sensitive pain” located (e.g., throat, chest, head, abdomen, or elsewhere)?
The sensitive pain is in my ear area—more like my ear feels very tender/sensitive. It’s not in my throat, chest, or abdomen.
intermediate_choice=K
Do you have any ear discharge (fluid or pus) coming from the affected ear?
No, I don’t have any ear discharge or fluid coming out.
intermediate_choice=AF
Do the episodes happen after eating or when lying down, and do you have heartburn or sour-tasting regurgitation?
It’s mostly when I’m lying down and at night—sometimes I wake up gasping or choking. I don’t really have heartburn or a sour taste in my mouth/regurgitation.
intermediate_choice=Q
**Do you have shortness of breath or low oxygen (e.g., trouble breathing at rest or with minimal activity)?**
No, I’m not short of breath, and I don’t feel like my oxygen is low. I mainly have a fever, cough, and burning pain around my face/nose and forehead.
intermediate_choice=A
Do you have nasal congestion or thick (yellow/green) nasal discharge with tenderness over your face/cheeks or forehead?
Yes. I have greenish-yellow nasal discharge, and my face/cheeks and forehead feel tender and painful, with burning pain too.
intermediate_choice=S
How long have you had these symptoms, and did they start suddenly or gradually?
I’ve had the symptoms for about 3–4 days. They came on gradually, not suddenly.
intermediate_choice=F
Do you have a fever (≥38°C) or chills?
No fever and no chills.
intermediate_choice=F
Do you have a sore throat, and if so how severe is it?
My throat feels a little itchy in the back, but I don’t really have a sore throat. The severity is mild, like more irritation than pain.
intermediate_choice=F
Do you have any facial pain/pressure or tooth pain, or is the nasal discharge turning thick/yellow-green?
I don’t have facial pain or pressure, and no tooth pain. My runny nose is clear, not thick or yellow-green.
intermediate_choice=F
Did you have any trouble breathing or throat tightness/swelling of your lips or tongue when the swelling and lightheadedness started?
Yes. I noticed swelling on my face and my nose/cheeks, and I also heard wheezing when I exhale. I felt some throat tightness/swelling at the same time as the lightheadedness.
intermediate_choice=V
Do you have any fever, nausea/vomiting, neck stiffness, or light sensitivity along with the head pain?
No—I don’t have a fever. I also don’t have nausea/vomiting, neck stiffness, or light sensitivity with the head pain.
intermediate_choice=AO
Did the near-fainting happen with standing up (lightheaded when standing), and has she actually had any loss of consciousness?
It feels worse when I stand up—I get lightheaded and feel like I might pass out. I haven’t fully lost consciousness though.
intermediate_choice=AO
Have you had any chest pain, palpitations, or shortness of breath with the near-fainting episodes?
No, I haven’t had chest pain, palpitations, or shortness of breath with the near-fainting.
intermediate_choice=AM
When she stands up, do you know if her heart rate increases a lot (for example, does her pulse feel very fast) or is she able to measure her blood pressure before and 1–3 minutes after standing?
I don’t know my pulse rate or blood pressure—I haven’t been able to measure them before and 1–3 minutes after standing. But I do feel like I get very lightheaded when I stand.
intermediate_choice=AE
Have you ever had your heart rate or blood pressure measured while lying down and again 1–3 minutes after standing (and what were the numbers)?
No, I haven’t had my heart rate or blood pressure checked while lying down and then again 1–3 minutes after standing, so I don’t have any numbers to tell you.
intermediate_choice=AE
When you stand and feel like you might pass out, do you also get blurred vision, ringing in the ears, or nausea (or does it improve quickly after sitting/lying down)?
I get lightheaded and feel like I might pass out, but I don’t have blurred vision or ringing in my ears. I also don’t get nausea with it—it improves when I sit or lie back down.
intermediate_choice=AM
Has she had any heart rate measurement or ECG done during symptoms (or does she feel a sudden onset of very fast, regular heartbeat)?
No, I haven’t had my heart rate or an ECG done during these symptoms. I also don’t feel a sudden onset of a very fast, regular heartbeat.
intermediate_choice=I
Has she ever fainted during exertion (e.g., running, sports), or do her symptoms ever occur while she is lying down?
No, I haven’t fainted during exertion or sports. And the symptoms mainly happen when I stand—I haven’t noticed them while I’m lying down.
intermediate_choice=AM
Has she ever had her blood pressure measured while lying down and again 1–3 minutes after standing (and if so, what were the two readings)?
I don’t know—no one has measured my blood pressure while lying down and then again 1–3 minutes after standing for me. I can’t give you two readings.
intermediate_choice=AM
Have you ever had your blood pressure and heart rate measured while lying down and again 1–3 minutes after standing (and if not, would you be willing to have it checked today)?
No, I haven’t had that checked before. Yes, I’d be willing to have my blood pressure and heart rate measured lying down and again after I stand today.
intermediate_choice=Q
Do you have chest pain (yes/no), and if yes what is its onset and character (sharp/pressure) and does it worsen with breathing?
No chest pain. I mainly feel significant shortness of breath, dizziness, and palpitations, especially when I exert myself.
intermediate_choice=N
Have you checked your pulse during an episode—does it feel very fast and regular (like a “racing” heartbeat) or irregular?
During the episodes it feels very fast, and it doesn’t feel perfectly steady—more like it can be irregular rather than a smooth regular racing.
intermediate_choice=N
During an episode, what is your heart rate (beats per minute) if you’ve measured it, and how long do the episodes last (minutes vs hours)?
I haven’t measured the exact heart rate in beats per minute. The episodes last for quite a while—more like hours rather than just minutes.
intermediate_choice=L
During an episode, have you checked your blood pressure and oxygen saturation (SpO₂) — and if so, what were the values?
I haven’t checked my oxygen saturation or my blood pressure during an episode, so I don’t know the numbers.
intermediate_choice=L
During an episode, have you been able to record an ECG or smartwatch heart tracing, and if so does it show an irregular rhythm or an organized fast rhythm (e.g., SVT)?
No, I haven’t recorded an ECG or smartwatch tracing during an episode. I only notice the palpitations by how it feels.
intermediate_choice=L
During an episode, have you checked your oxygen saturation (SpO₂) and, if so, what was the value?
No, I haven’t checked my oxygen saturation (SpO₂) during an episode, so I don’t know the value.
intermediate_choice=L
During an episode, have you ever checked your heart rate with a pulse/fitness watch (and what number did it show)?
No, I haven’t checked my heart rate with a watch during an episode, so I don’t have a number.
intermediate_choice=Y

During an episode, have you ever checked your heart rhythm with an ECG (in a clinic/urgent care) or captured a tracing on a smartwatch to confirm whether it’s irregularly irregular (atrial fibrillation) versus a regular fast rhythm (SVT)?
No—I haven’t had an ECG done during an episode or captured a tracing on a smartwatch. I only feel the palpitations.
intermediate_choice=L
During an episode, have you measured your oxygen saturation (SpO₂) and if so what was the value?
No, I haven’t measured my oxygen saturation (SpO₂) during an episode, so I don’t know the value.
intermediate_choice=L
Have you ever had fainting or near-fainting during these episodes, and if so what were you doing when it happened?
I’ve had dizziness, but I don’t think I actually fainted. I mostly notice it while I’m active or exerting myself.
intermediate_choice=L
Does the chest pain get worse with exertion or improve with rest (and/or does it radiate to your arm, jaw, or back)?

It’s very bad and it feels like it goes through to my thoracic spine and up to my left scapula. I don’t know about exertion—right now it feels constant and intense, not really better with rest. It also comes with a sharp “knife stroke” feeling and nausea, and I keep vomiting.
intermediate_choice=M
How long has the coughing up blood been happening, and is it small streaks or a larger amount?
It’s been happening for a short time, not months. The amount looks more than just a few small streaks—it’s enough that I notice the blood in the sputum.
intermediate_choice=H
Do you have a fever or chills along with the coughing up blood?
I don’t think I’ve had fever or chills with it. I’ve mainly noticed the cough and the blood in the sputum.
intermediate_choice=H
Do you have any shortness of breath or chest pain (especially when breathing in)?
I don’t have chest pain. I’m not sure about shortness of breath—I haven’t really noticed it.
intermediate_choice=H
What is the patient’s age and current oxygen saturation (or, if you don’t have a reading, does she feel short of breath at rest or when walking)?
I’m 13 years old. I don’t have an oxygen saturation reading, but I don’t feel really short of breath at rest; it’s mostly connected to coughing.
intermediate_choice=H
Have you had any chest pain (especially sharp pain when you breathe in) or shortness of breath that is worse than expected for your cough?
No chest pain. And no—my breathing doesn’t feel much worse than I’d expect just from the cough.
intermediate_choice=AC
Have you had a recent nosebleed or can you tell whether the blood seems to be coming from your nose/throat rather than from deep in your chest?
I don’t recall a recent nosebleed. The blood seems mixed in with my cough/phlegm, like it’s coming from my lungs or chest rather than from my nose or throat.
intermediate_choice=AC
Have you had any recent weight loss, night sweats, or known exposure to tuberculosis?
I don’t think I’ve had weight loss or night sweats. I also don’t have known exposure to tuberculosis.
intermediate_choice=AO
What is her current oxygen saturation (SpO₂) and has she had any bluish lips or visible trouble breathing?
I don’t have an SpO₂ reading. I haven’t noticed bluish lips, and I’m not visibly having trouble breathing.
intermediate_choice=AP
Have you had a recent chest injury or violent coughing episode, or do you have sharp pain on one side of the chest that is worse with deep breaths?
No chest injury. I don’t have sharp one-sided chest pain that gets worse with deep breaths—just the cough and the blood in the sputum.
intermediate_choice=AP
Have you had a measured fever (≥38°C) or any known sick contacts in the past week?
I don’t think I’ve had a measured fever of 38°C or higher. And I don’t know of any sick contacts in the past week.
intermediate_choice=AP
Do you have a fever or chills, and if so what is the highest temperature you’ve measured?
I don’t think I’ve had a fever or chills. I don’t remember measuring any high temperature.
intermediate_choice=AJ
Are you having any shortness of breath or trouble breathing, and if so how severe is it?
Yes, I’m having shortness of breath and trouble breathing. It feels significant/difficult, especially with my coughing and the wheezing when I breathe out.
intermediate_choice=AJ
What is your current oxygen saturation (SpO₂) measured on a pulse oximeter, and have you had any drop below 92%?
I don’t know my oxygen saturation number right now, and I haven’t been told if it dropped below 92%.
intermediate_choice=AK
Have you had any recent chest imaging (chest X‑ray or CT), and if so what was the result?
No, I haven’t had any recent chest X‑ray or CT scan.
intermediate_choice=AJ
Have you had any recent chest X-ray or CT within the last 24–48 hours, and if not, would you be able to get one today?
No, I haven’t had any chest X-ray or CT in the last 24–48 hours. If you think I need it, yes, I can get one today.
intermediate_choice=AJ
What is your current heart rate (pulse) measured right now?
I don’t know my current heart rate/pulse right now.
intermediate_choice=AJ
Have you noticed any new leg swelling or pain, or are you coughing up blood?
No, I haven’t noticed any new leg swelling or leg pain, and I’m not coughing up blood.
intermediate_choice=AJ
Are you able to speak full sentences without stopping for breath (yes/no)?
No. I can’t speak full sentences without stopping because my breathing feels very hard.
intermediate_choice=AJ
Have you noticed any chest pain that is worse with deep breathing or coughing?
Yes. My upper chest pain gets worse with coughing and deep breathing, and it feels sensitive/burning.
intermediate_choice=AJ
What is your respiratory rate (how many breaths per minute) or, if you don’t know, do you appear to be breathing much faster than usual?
I don’t know my respiratory rate. But I do look and feel like I’m breathing faster than usual because I’m quite short of breath and wheezy when I exhale.
intermediate_choice=AK
Do you have a fever or chills (or how high has your temperature been, if you’ve checked)?
I don’t think I’ve had a fever or chills. I haven’t checked my temperature at home, so I can’t tell you a number.
intermediate_choice=T
Do you have a history of asthma/COPD, and have you used an inhaler (or steroids) for this before?

Yes—I’ve had asthma attacks before, and I’ve needed to use a bronchodilator/inhaler for them. I’ve also been diagnosed with chronic sinusitis, and I’ve had two or more asthma attacks in the past year.
intermediate_choice=T
Do you have a cough or sore throat?
No, I don’t have a cough or a sore throat.
intermediate_choice=R
Where exactly is the pain located, and does it worsen with breathing in or with lying flat?
The pain is in my head—back of my head, my forehead, and on the left temple. I don’t know about it getting worse with breathing in or when lying flat; I haven’t noticed that.
intermediate_choice=R
Do you have a stiff neck or pain when you try to touch your chin to your chest?
I don’t have a stiff neck, and I haven’t noticed pain when I try to touch my chin to my chest.
intermediate_choice=R
Do you have nasal congestion or thick/purulent nasal discharge (or facial/sinus pain that worsens when you lean forward)?
No, I don’t have nasal congestion or thick/purulent nasal discharge, and I don’t have facial or sinus pain that gets worse when I lean forward.
intermediate_choice=R
Do you have light sensitivity (do bright lights make the headache worse) or any confusion or trouble speaking?
No, I don’t have light sensitivity. I also don’t feel confused, and I don’t have trouble speaking.
intermediate_choice=R
Have you measured your temperature (and if so, what is the highest reading), and when did the fever and headache start?
I’ve had a fever, but I haven’t measured the temperature or checked the highest reading. The fever and headache started around the same time, not too long ago—early today.
intermediate_choice=R
Have you checked whether you have a rash (especially small red/purple spots) anywhere on your body?
No, I haven’t noticed any rash or small red/purple spots on my body.
intermediate_choice=R
Have you measured your temperature (exact number) and do you have body aches or fatigue?
I haven’t measured my temperature with an exact number. Yes, I feel fatigue and I have that exhausting feeling with the illness.
intermediate_choice=R
Have you measured your temperature today (what exact number)?
No, I haven’t measured the temperature today with an exact number.
intermediate_choice=R
Have you checked your temperature with a thermometer, and what is the exact number right now?
No, I haven’t checked with a thermometer, so I don’t have an exact number right now.
intermediate_choice=R
Do you have any fever or shortness of breath (yes/no)?
No fever. No shortness of breath.
intermediate_choice=F
Do you have any nasal congestion or thick/discolored nasal discharge (including post-nasal drip) along with the forehead pain?
Yes—my nose is congested, and I have greenish/yellowish thick discharge with some post-nasal drip. Yes, it comes with the forehead pain.
intermediate_choice=F
How long have your nasal symptoms and forehead pain been going on (in days)?
About 14 days—my cold and the forehead pain started around the last two weeks.
intermediate_choice=F
Have you had any worsening symptoms after an initial improvement (a “double-worsening” pattern) since this started about 14 days ago?
Yes, it feels like it got a little better at first, then got worse again over the last several days.
intermediate_choice=F
Where exactly is the pain located (e.g., throat, ear, chest, abdomen, one side of the body), and does it worsen with breathing, swallowing, or movement?

The pain is mostly in my head—around the forehead and my right and left temples, and also my right cheek. It doesn’t feel like throat, ear, chest, or belly pain, and it doesn’t get worse when breathing, swallowing, or moving.
intermediate_choice=J
Do you have nasal congestion or thick/yellow-green nasal discharge (or recent cold symptoms), and is the pain worse when you bend forward?
Yes, I have nasal congestion and a clear runny nose. I don’t know about thick or yellow-green discharge, and the pain doesn’t seem worse when I bend forward.
intermediate_choice=D
Do you have a fever or facial pain/tenderness when you press on your cheeks or around your eyes?
I don’t have a fever. I do have pain around my right cheek and my forehead/right and left temples, but I’m not sure if it’s tender when someone presses on my cheeks or around my eyes.
intermediate_choice=U
How many days has the headache/face pain been going on?
It’s been going on for a short time—started very fast, like in minutes. I can’t say the exact number of days, but it began today.
intermediate_choice=U
Do you have any clear-to-yellow or thick nasal discharge, or pain/pressure when you press over your cheeks or between/around your eyes?
No, I don’t have clear-to-yellow or thick nasal discharge—just a clear runny nose. And I’m not sure about pain/pressure when pressing over my cheeks or around my eyes.
intermediate_choice=U
Have you had any vision changes (blurred/double vision), eye redness, or pain when moving your eyes?
No, I don’t have blurred or double vision. I’m not sure about eye redness, and it doesn’t hurt when I move my eyes.
intermediate_choice=U
Do you have any tooth pain (upper teeth) or pain/pressure that is worse when you chew?
No, I don’t have tooth pain or pain that gets worse when I chew.
intermediate_choice=U
Does he have a barking cough or stridor (noisy breathing, especially when inhaling)?
Yes. He has a noisy breathing sound—like stridor—especially when he breathes in, and his cough sounds more like a barking cough.
intermediate_choice=AC
Do you have shortness of breath or chest pain that worsens when you take a deep breath?
I have upper chest pain and it burns. I don’t notice it getting worse when I take a deep breath—mostly it gets worse after eating and with heartburn.
intermediate_choice=H
Does your child have a sore throat or pain when swallowing?
Yes. She has a sore throat, and it feels painful around swallowing.
intermediate_choice=O
Does she have a cough?
No, she doesn’t have a cough.
intermediate_choice=V
Does she have trouble breathing or noisy breathing (stridor), or drool because she can’t swallow?
No, she doesn’t have trouble breathing, noisy breathing, or drool because she can’t swallow.
intermediate_choice=AE
Do you have a fever (or measured temperature) and, if so, how high and for how many days?
I don’t know my measured temperature, but I’ve had chills/shivers and I’m sweating a lot. I’ve felt sick for about 2–3 days so far.
intermediate_choice=J
Are you coughing up any phlegm (sputum), and if so what color is it?
I have a cough, but I’m not coughing up any phlegm right now—so I can’t say the color.
intermediate_choice=AA
Are you short of breath or having chest pain that gets worse when you breathe in?
I don’t have shortness of breath. I also don’t have chest pain that gets worse when I breathe in.
intermediate_choice=AA
Have you measured your oxygen saturation (SpO₂) or noticed any worsening shortness of breath with walking?
No, I haven’t measured my oxygen saturation. And I haven’t noticed worsening shortness of breath when I walk.
intermediate_choice=D
Have you noticed any chest pain or pain with deep breathing (pleuritic pain), or any worsening pain when coughing?

I don’t have chest pain or pain when I take a deep breath. My pain is more all over with my head and back of the neck, and it feels exhausting when I’m coughing, but I don’t feel like it’s chest pleuritic pain.
intermediate_choice=X
Have you noticed any measured fever (temperature) at home or in a pharmacy/urgent care, and if so what was the highest number?
I haven’t measured my temperature at home or anywhere, so I don’t know the highest number. I’ve had chills/shivers and sweating though.
intermediate_choice=X
Have you noticed any new shortness of breath, wheezing, or chest tightness when resting or at night?
No. I’m not feeling short of breath, wheezing, or chest tightness even at rest or at night.
intermediate_choice=X
Have you noticed any shortness of breath or rapid breathing when walking up a flight of stairs (or when speaking more than a few sentences)?
No, I don’t notice shortness of breath or rapid breathing when I walk upstairs or when I talk.
intermediate_choice=D
Have you noticed any foul-smelling sputum, blood in your sputum, or pain in your chest when you cough?
No foul-smelling sputum, no blood in my sputum, and no specific chest pain when I cough. The main problems are my cough plus the painful, sensitive pain in my head and neck, with severe fatigue.
intermediate_choice=X
Have you noticed any sore throat or runny/stuffy nose since the symptoms started?
Yes, I have a sore throat. I don’t know about runny or stuffy nose—I haven’t noticed that.
intermediate_choice=D
During or after coughing spells, does he ever make a high-pitched “whoop” sound or vomit right after the cough?
No, I don’t think so—he hasn’t made any “whoop” sound, and he hasn’t vomited right after the cough spells.
intermediate_choice=D
How long has the coughing been going on (in days/weeks), and is it getting worse over time?
It started recently—within a few days. It feels like it’s getting worse, especially the pain during the coughing fits.
intermediate_choice=Q
Does he have any fever or trouble breathing (fast breathing, wheezing, or shortness of breath) along with the coughing fits?
I don’t think he has a fever. He’s breathing okay—no wheezing or shortness of breath that I’ve noticed.
intermediate_choice=D
During the coughing fits, does he ever have trouble breathing or noisy breathing/whistling when he inhales (stridor) or when he exhales (wheezing)?
No, I haven’t noticed any noisy breathing like wheezing or whistling, and he doesn’t seem to have trouble breathing during the coughing fits.
intermediate_choice=D
During the coughing fits, does he ever have vomiting or a high-pitched whoop sound afterward, even once?
No—he hasn’t vomited after the coughing, and I haven’t heard any high-pitched “whoop” sound afterward.
intermediate_choice=D
Does he have any fever, or has anyone measured his temperature during this illness?
No fever that we’ve measured, and nobody has told me his temperature was high.
intermediate_choice=D
During the coughing fits, is the cough in repeated bursts that come in spells (e.g., many coughs in a row) and does he look/act well between spells?
Yes, it comes in bursts/spells—lots of coughing in a row. Between the spells he seems okay, not too sick.
intermediate_choice=B
During the coughing spells, has his lips or face ever turned blue or has anyone measured his oxygen saturation (SpO₂) to see if it drops?
No, his lips or face haven’t turned blue. I haven’t had his oxygen level measured.
intermediate_choice=D
Has he had any episodes of coughing that cause him to choke or turn red/pale and/or have trouble catching his breath during the spells?
He gets very uncomfortable and looks pale, but I don’t think he chokes. He doesn’t seem to have trouble catching his breath during the cough spells.
intermediate_choice=D
During the coughing spells, does he ever stop breathing or turn blue (even briefly) before the cough improves?
No, he doesn’t stop breathing and he doesn’t turn blue, even briefly.
intermediate_choice=D
Do you have a fever and drooling with difficulty swallowing or muffled (“hot potato”) voice?
I don’t have a fever. I’m also not drooling, and I don’t feel like I have trouble swallowing or a “hot potato” muffled voice.
intermediate_choice=Y
Did your stridor start suddenly (within minutes to hours) or gradually (over days)?
It started kind of suddenly—within a few hours—not gradually over days.
intermediate_choice=I
Did the stridor start after a choking episode or possible aspiration of a foreign body?
No, it didn’t start after choking or anything like swallowing a foreign object.
intermediate_choice=Y
Do you have any rash, hives, or swelling of your lips/tongue (or have you recently been exposed to a new food/medication)?
No rash or hives, and no swelling of my lips or tongue. I haven’t had any new food or medication recently.
intermediate_choice=Y
Do you have trouble breathing—especially when inhaling—and does it get worse when lying flat?
Yes, I feel it’s hard to breathe, especially when I inhale. I’m not sure about lying flat—it doesn’t feel much worse when I’m flat.
intermediate_choice=Y
Are you able to speak full sentences without stopping to catch your breath (or is your voice too weak/limited to speak)?
Yes, I can speak full sentences. My voice isn’t weak or limited—I can talk normally.
intermediate_choice=Y
Have you noticed a change in your voice quality (hoarseness) or any pain when speaking or swallowing?
My voice feels a bit different—more hoarse than usual—but I don’t have pain when speaking or swallowing.
intermediate_choice=Y
Have you had any cough—especially a barking (“seal-like”) cough—or recent cold/URTI symptoms in the last few days?
Yes, I’ve had cold/URTI symptoms in the last couple of weeks, and I have a cough too. It’s not a barking “seal-like” cough, though.
intermediate_choice=I
Do you have audible wheezing or does your breathing sound like a “high-pitched” noise only when you inhale?
I hear a high-pitched noise when I inhale. I don’t know if it’s wheezing like from the chest.
intermediate_choice=I
Do you notice your breathing sounds worse when you’re upright and improves when you sit forward (or is there any relief with leaning forward)?
Yes, it feels a little better when I sit forward, and worse when I’m more upright.
intermediate_choice=I
Do you have shortness of breath or chest pain, especially when breathing in or at rest?
No—I don’t have shortness of breath or chest pain, either at rest or when breathing in.
intermediate_choice=A
